Public Telegram/X identity plus Press TV quotation/hosting relationship established. A bounded March 18–28 source-behavior review now records six distinct qualifying information events: Netanyahu-death speculation stated as fact, the F-35/F-15E misidentification, a recycled 2020 Sara Netanyahu video used as current-condition evidence, the two-missile/all-damage causal claim, scope mutation of Trump's energy-plant pause plus an unsupported invasion-motive attribution, and a population-wide 'lost public support' conclusion contradicted by representative polling. These incidents are counted at publication-event level, not per atomic proposition. The deterministic Bullshitter award must be derived, not manually assigned.

Facebook and X resolve to the same Iran Military Update account brand; real-world operator remains unknown. One July 6 WOL-native behavior incident is established: a massive anti-Trump funeral crowd was generalized into 'The people of Iran hate Trump.' The crowd and anger are real; the population-wide conclusion is not established by a self-selected funeral/political crowd. No operator, state-control or IRGC-control inference follows. One incident does not earn a Bullshitter award.

Public identity resolves to Russell Ellis / Jolly Good Ginger. Expanded Iran-war review found political/anti-war advocacy and commentary, but no preserved factual Iran-war assertion that currently satisfies the WOL no-support evidence gate. Advocacy, opinion and broad political rhetoric do not count merely because they are antagonistic or contestable. Keep unscored unless later claim-first research produces a receipts-backed factual incident.

The July 20 Hormuz commentary contains one WOL-native unsupported causal-inference incident. Its transit-count substrate is substantially supported, but the observed sequence does not isolate successive U.S. strike waves as the demonstrated cause of the shipping shutdown amid Iranian vessel attacks, blockade/escalation risk, commercial insurance/crew decisions and incomplete AIS visibility. The existing causal proposition remains separately routed upstream. One incident does not earn a Bullshitter award.

A bounded July 17–August 15 review now records six distinct qualifying MeidasTouch publication events. The recurring pattern preserves a severe factual substrate—Iranian vessel attacks, genuine U.S. munitions depletion, extensive base damage and Bahrain logistics disruption—while repeatedly converting that substrate into unsupported absolutes such as seven tankers destroyed, zero Patriot/THAAD inventory, the U.S. out of all weapons, and essentially all regional U.S. bases destroyed/obliterated. Repeated publications count separately; multiple atomic propositions inside one episode count once. The deterministic Bullshitter award must be derived rather than manually assigned. The older July 12 broad-base-destruction discovery remains separately queued for upstream canonical atomization and is not needed to earn the source-behavior award.
